projects.title: ML-based weather forecasting
projects.excerpt: Weather predictor that ingests historical data to forecast short-term conditions with a reproducible pipeline.

details.heading: Highlights
items: Automated data cleaning, feature engineering, and train/validate splits.
Model training with cross-validation and metrics reporting.
Configurable forecasting horizons and evaluation windows.
Lightweight CLI/notebook workflows for quick iteration.
details.outcome: Actionable short-term forecasts with transparent metrics and a maintainable pipeline.

projects.title: Face comparison application
projects.excerpt: Detects and compares faces in images to estimate similarity and flag likely matches.

details.heading: Highlights
items: Drag-and-drop image ingestion with validation.
Face detection pipeline using Haar cascades.
Visual overlays communicating match confidence.
Modular architecture for alternative models.
details.outcome: Practical tool to quickly verify whether two images likely depict the same person.

projects.title: Unity Turn-Based Card Battler (Game Jam)
projects.excerpt: Turn-based card battler developed for a Game Jam, featuring strategic card mechanics, enemy combat system, and complete game loop with win/lose conditions.

details.heading: Key Features Implemented
items: Card system with Attack, Defence, and Buff/Debuff mechanics with drag-and-drop card zones.
Combat system featuring enemy AI, damage calculation, and stamina management.
Complete game loop with round progression, win/lose conditions, and game-over menus.
Multiple balance patches and backend gameplay refinements.
UI/UX improvements including HUD updates and polished animations.
Extensive bug fixes and prefab optimization to prevent overlapping issues.
details.outcome: Fully playable turn-based card battler with polished combat mechanics and balanced gameplay.

projects.title: Unity Game Development - Backend & Graphics
projects.excerpt: Comprehensive Unity game project focusing on backend game logic, shader development, and modular architecture for efficient game structure.

details.heading: Technical Implementation
items: Backend development with C# for game mechanics, object behaviors, physics, and event handling systems.
Script architecture managing logic, interaction triggers, and gameplay functionality.
Graphics and visual effects using ShaderLab and HLSL for custom rendering, lighting optimization, and graphical fidelity.
Well-structured prefab system with modular game objects ensuring reusability and efficient hierarchy.
Integrated game structure combining backend logic, scripting, and shader development for cohesive project.
details.outcome: Complete game backend with optimized shaders and organized modular architecture for scalable development.

projects.title: Game Knight - Shader & Gameplay Development
projects.excerpt: Unity project emphasizing custom shader development , gameplay scripting , and graphics pipeline optimization, with focus on enemy AI and pathfinding logic.

details.heading: Technical Breakdown
items: ShaderLab development  for custom graphics, lighting effects, and visual aesthetics enhancement.
C# scripting  for game mechanics, object interactions, physics systems, and AI behavior logic.
HLSL programming for low-level graphics pipeline development and visual optimizations.
Enemy behavior logic and AI systems for combat encounters and decision-making.
Pathfinding algorithms and navigation logic for enemy movement and spatial awareness.
Organized backend scripts, prefabs, and modular structure supporting iterative testing and development.
details.outcome: Graphics-focused Unity project with sophisticated shader systems and intelligent enemy AI behavior.

projects.title: CommerceHub - AI Inventory Management
projects.excerpt: AI-powered inventory backend for e-commerce using ARIMA forecasting to predict stockouts, optimize reorder timing, and generate intelligent inventory recommendations.

details.heading: Highlights
items: Backend API development with FastAPI and RESTful endpoints.
ARIMA-based demand forecasting with exponential smoothing fallback.
ETL pipeline for data processing and feature engineering.
Intelligent recommendation engine with 7 types of insights (stockouts, trending products, slow movers, seasonal patterns, overstock alerts, price optimization, stock balancing).
Shopify integration API for product and inventory sync.
SQLAlchemy ORM for data persistence and PostgreSQL database design.
details.outcome: Built complete backend infrastructure for AI-driven inventory management system
